abstract_sentences.text: Despite their ability to understand chemical knowledge, large language models (LLMs) remain limited in their capacity to propose novel molecules with desired functions (e.g., drug-like properties).

evidence.anchor: LLMs remain limited in their capacity to propose novel molecules

abstract_sentences.text: In addition, the molecules that LLMs propose can often be challenging to make, and are almost never compatible with automated synthesis approaches.

evidence.anchor: almost never compatible with automated synthesis approaches

abstract_sentences.text: To better enable the discovery of functional small molecules, LLMs need to learn a new molecular language that is more effective in predicting properties and inherently synced with automated synthesis technology.

evidence.anchor: learn a new molecular language

abstract_sentences.text: Current molecule LLMs are limited by representing molecules based on atoms.

evidence.anchor: limited by representing molecules based on atoms

abstract_sentences.text: In this paper, we argue that just like tokenizing texts into meaning-bearing (sub-)word tokens instead of characters, molecules should be tokenized at the level of functional building blocks, i.e., parts of molecules that bring unique functions and serve as effective building blocks for real-world automated laboratory synthesis.

evidence.anchor: molecules should be tokenized at the level of functional building blocks

abstract_sentences.text: This motivates us to propose mCLM, a modular Chemical-Language Model that comprises a bilingual language model that understands both natural language descriptions of functions and molecular blocks.

evidence.anchor: understands both natural language descriptions of functions and molecular blocks

abstract_sentences.text: mCLM front-loads synthesizability considerations while improving the predicted functions of molecules in a principled manner.

evidence.anchor: front-loads synthesizability considerations

abstract_sentences.text: Experiments on 430 FDA-approved drugs showed that mCLM is capable of significantly improving chemical functions critical to determining drug potentials.

evidence.anchor: Experiments on 430 FDA-approved drugs

abstract_sentences.text: mCLM, with only 3B parameters, also achieves improvements in synthetic accessibility relative to 7 other leading generative AI methods including GPT-5.

evidence.anchor: relative to 7 other leading generative AI methods

abstract_sentences.text: When tested on 122 out-of-distribution medicines using only building blocks/tokens that are compatible with automated modular synthesis, mCLM outperforms all baselines in property scores and synthetic accessibility.

evidence.anchor: tested on 122 out-of-distribution medicines

abstract_sentences.text: mCLM can also reason on multiple functions and iteratively self-improve to rescue drug candidates that failed late in clinical trials (“fallen angels”).

evidence.anchor: iteratively self-improve to rescue drug candidates

abstract_summary.reported_results: 430 FDA drugs、3B parameters、7 baselines、122 OOD medicines、fallen-angels case；未报告表格的具体数值、区间或检验对象。
abstract_summary.theory_and_limitations: 没有 theorem/guarantee formula；synthesis/function design 被称为 guarantee/front-load，但摘要没有列出条件或 wet-lab limitation。
abstract_summary.strongest_claim_location: 后半段句 9–10 的 baseline/OOD 比较，句 11 的 iterative rescue 作为能力收尾。

method_summary.formal_objects: V、building-block graph、placeholders [1*]/[2*]/[3*]、Transformer contextual state c_i、natural token embedding e_v、GNN/adaptor parameters ϕ/ψ、current molecule M。
method_summary.inputs_outputs: 输入 natural-language prompt 与 molecule/block context；输出下一 token 或经过 iterative reasoning 的 refined molecule。

components_to_problems.synthesis_guaranteed_tokenizer: 把 automated synthesis constraints 前置，解决 generated structures 的 makeability gap。
components_to_problems.coverage_check_rule_tokenizer: 在不能完整覆盖时保留 training diversity；rule-based fallback 只用于 training。
components_to_problems.GNN_adaptor: 把 block graph 转入 LLM embedding space，支持 unseen blocks。
components_to_problems.code_switched_decoder: 联合 function language 与 molecule blocks，解决单模态功能知识缺口。
components_to_problems.critical_reasoning: 按属性迭代局部改块，处理 multi-objective trade-off。

experimental_design.name: ADMET oracle tasks
experimental_design.description: 从 TDC 选 AMES、BBBP、CYP3A4 inhibition、DILI、HIA、PGP 六项，分别对应 mutagenicity、BBB permeability、metabolism、liver injury、intestinal absorption、P-gp substrate。

evidence.anchor: We select 6 tasks from the Therapeutics Data Commons

experimental_design.name: Oracle 训练与筛选
experimental_design.description: 评估 TDC 的 22 个 ADMET classification tasks，保留标准模型 AUC > 0.80 的任务；FARM、ChemBERTa-2、GNN 以 stacking 形成 ensemble；validation threshold 取最大 F1；scaffold split 为 8:1:1。

evidence.anchor: TDC provides predefined scaffold-based data splits with an 8:1:1 ratio

experimental_design.name: FDA 主测试
experimental_design.description: 122 个由 synthesis-guaranteed blocks 组成的 FDA-approved structures、153 unseen blocks；输出 vocabulary 限为 582 个 synthesis-guaranteed blocks；120/122 含未进入 1000-block training vocabulary 的 blocks。

evidence.anchor: This amounts to 122 molecular structures and 153 unseen blocks

experimental_design.name: 扩展 FDA 测试
experimental_design.description: A.2 取至少 3 blocks 的 430 个 FDA drugs，无 synthesis guarantees；796 unseen blocks，426/430 含未见 blocks；strict tokenizer 覆盖 corpus 的 26.7%。

evidence.anchor: This amounts to 430 molecular structures and 796 unseen blocks

experimental_design.name: Baselines
experimental_design.description: MoleculeSTM、FineMolTex、GPT-4o、GPT-5、Gemini-2.5-Flash、LDMol、Claude-3.5-Haiku，并追加 DGAE 与 HierVAE；主文说明 baseline 可无 synthesis guarantee 地生成。

evidence.anchor: including MoleculeSTM ... GPT-5 ... Claude 3.5 Haiku

experimental_design.name: Synthesizability protocol
experimental_design.description: SA score 作为 quick heuristic；Allchemy 作为 retrosynthesis search。按 SA 选 mCLM、MoleculeSTM、FineMolTex，各随机抽 200 个，在 supercomputing cluster 上每个 molecule 30 分钟，substrate 不设 price limit。

evidence.anchor: randomly sample 200 generated molecules from each
We gave each molecule 30 minutes on a supercomputing cluster

experimental_design.name: Fallen-angels case
experimental_design.description: Evobrutinib/BTK 与 TNG348/USP1；先优化 DILI，再修复上一步恶化的 PGP 或 BBBP，最后改善 AMES 或 CYP3A4；此实验不施加 synthesis vocabulary restriction。

evidence.anchor: without synthesis restrictions on the vocabulary

experimental_design.description: 统计 mCLM 为 FDA drugs 改善 DILI 时最常提出的 blocks；Figure 5 展示四类修改，并把 modification 3 与 amphotericin B toxicity 研究作相似性对照。

experimental_design.description: Qwen2.5-3B；4×A100 80GB、bfloat16；pretraining 为 adaptor-only 1 epoch + GNN embeddings frozen 5 epochs；property optimization fine-tune 每 property 5 epochs、100k examples；learning rate、scheduler、optimizer 在 E 中给出。

final_judgment.single_storyline: 把 tokenization 从 atom/SMILES 字符提升为带功能语义且遵守 automated block chemistry 的 graph building blocks，再以 GNN–adaptor–Qwen bilingual decoder 和 iterative property editing 把功能预测与可制造性放入同一生成路径。[p.3–7, §1–§2]
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: Figure 1–3 的表示/流程，六项 ADMET、122-drug/OOD 设计，Table 1–2 数值，Allchemy 口径，以及两个 fallen-angels 轨迹留在正文，承担机制、决策和案例判断。[p.2、p.5、p.7–9]
final_judgment.appendix_moves: oracle/scaffold split、训练 lr/GPU/epochs、模板与数据计数、placeholder exact reconstruction、额外 baseline 和消融移到 A–I；迁移使正文紧凑，但 oracle 可靠性、tokenizer 可逆性和 baseline 公平性不能只读正文判断。[p.20–33]
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 3 是可检查的 guarantee/fallback pipeline；Table 1/2 并置 property 与 makeability；Figure 4 标出逐步目标和数值；Appendix F 用 imatinib placeholders 展示 exact reconstruction。[p.5、p.7–9、p.27]
final_judgment.largest_gap: “guarantee/physical-world link”强于证据：主要证据是 predefined reactions、Allchemy route search 和 starting-block 假设，没有本论文 wet-lab synthesis、property uncertainty 或独立 human/clinical endpoint；另有 Table 2 数值口径和 TNG348/TNG248 名称冲突。[p.8、p.20、p.32]
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 功能、生成、制造若被作为同一能力，正文应同时给出可逆结构对象、主要任务分母与 baseline、独立失败/消融证据，并把数字评估和 physical validation 分开命名。[p.5–9, §2–§3]
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于有结构化 action space 与真实执行约束的生成研究；仅有离线预测且没有可验证执行环节时，约束 token 不能自动等同 end-to-end capability。[p.5–6, §2.1；p.8, §3.2]
